_comment: Allow/deny lists. No secrets here. NVIDIA and AMD have no reliable 'free' flag in their model lists, so only allow-listed ids join the pool.

groups._comment: STARTER lists, not benchmarked. Built from measured latency (probe-chat), reasoning flags and model names. 'match' = substring of the canonical model name. Edit freely; an empty group falls back to the whole pool.
